verdict.rationale: Manufact lets you paste an existing MCP server URL and connects to it directly for Chat, testing, and the publish workflow, and it runs test scenarios against servers across MCP clients and LLM models. That makes it an MCP client of sorts, but the connection is for developing and validating your own server rather than for a general agent that uses arbitrary plugged-in tools in everyday work. missing for 10: documentation of the Chat experience actually invoking connected servers' tools, support for combining multiple third-party MCP servers as a general tool source, independent or hands-on corroboration.
